intro: Tyrande Whisperwind is the High Priestess of Elune and the supreme leader of the night elves. Alongside her beloved, the Archdruid Malfurion Stormrage, she guided her people through the cataclysmic War of the Ancients and ten millennia of the Long Vigil. Now governing from the sacred boughs of Teldrassil, she commands the Sisterhood of Elune and directs the Sentinel army in defense of Kalimdor's sacred wilderness.

p: Born in the ancient kaldorei empire, Tyrande grew up alongside the twin brothers Malfurion and Illidan Stormrage. While the brothers followed druidism and sorcery, Tyrande entered the service of Elune as a priestess. When the demonic Burning Legion first invaded Azeroth during the War of the Ancients, she stood against it at Malfurion's side. Blessed with direct favor from the Moon Goddess, Tyrande transformed the Sisterhood into a radiant fighting force, wielding both divine restoration and searing lunar wrath to deliver her people from the brink of total annihilation.

sections.t: The Long Vigil and the Sentinels
p: Following the Great Sundering and the sealing of the Well of Eternity, Malfurion and the druids entered the Emerald Dream for deep, prolonged hibernations. Tyrande took upon herself the lonely burden of defending their recovering realm. She organized the Sentinels—an elite cadre of warrior-women who patrolled Kalimdor's forests for ten thousand years. Throughout this Long Vigil, she stood watchful guard over ancient evils and lingering demonic remnants, maintaining unbroken faith in Elune while she waited centuries between brief reunions with Malfurion.

sections.t: The Third War and a New Haven
p: When the Burning Legion returned during the Third War, Tyrande acted decisively to wake the sleeping druids and face the catastrophic threat. Overcoming fierce mistrust toward the newly arrived orcs and humans, she helped forge the desperate coalition at Mount Hyjal, sacrificing the night elves' immortality atop Nordrassil to shatter Archimonde. With Mount Hyjal scarred and Malfurion once again occupied with safeguarding the Emerald Dream, Tyrande governs the kaldorei from the grand Temple of the Moon in Darnassus, watching cautiously over both Horde incursions and her people's new place in the Alliance.
